subject.cedVersion: AP Biology CED (V.1, (c)2025; 2027 exam hybrid digital)
subject.designNotes: Unit/topic codes, titles (shortened where long), class periods, MC unit weights and per-topic suggested skills follow the CED. Exam: 60 MC questions (50%, 90 min) + 6 FRQ (50%, 90 min) per CED exam overview. The CED publishes no percentage weights per science practice, so no skill weights are recorded; all six practices are assessed in both sections. Sub-keywords, kinds, prerequisites and estLessons are original tutoring-design judgement, not CED content. Sub-keyword skill codes default to the topic's first suggested skill unless a more specific one is given. Per-topic 'skills' list the CED suggested skills (CED lists one to two per topic).
